items.name: Run SFC /scannow
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: Scans and repairs corrupted system files using System File Checker.

items.name: Check Disk (Scan Only)
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: Runs CHKDSK in scan mode to look for file system errors without fixing.

items.name: Check Disk (Fix Errors)
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: Schedules CHKDSK with repair on next reboot to fix file system errors.
items.warningBody: This will schedule CHKDSK with repair on the system drive. It may take a long time and requires a reboot.

items.name: Rebuild Icon Cache
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: Clears and rebuilds icon cache to fix broken icons and some Explorer slowdowns.

args: Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\iconcache*' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Process explorer.exe

items.name: Rebuild Font Cache
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: Stops the font cache service, clears cache data, and restarts it to fix UI/text issues.

args: Stop-Service -Name 'FontCache' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -LiteralPath '$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Windows\FontCache\*' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service -Name 'FontCache' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

items.name: Run DISM full health repair
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: Runs a full DISM health repair pass (CheckHealth + ScanHealth + RestoreHealth behavior) in one shot. Use this when system image corruption is suspected.

items.name: Scan & Fix Drive Errors
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: [Focus: Stability] Runs Windows volume scan/repair (Repair-Volume -Scan) for all fixed drives.

args: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $drives = Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.DriveLetter -and $_.DriveType -eq 'Fixed' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty DriveLetter; foreach($d in $drives){ try { Repair-Volume -DriveLetter $d -Scan } catch { } }

items.name: Scan & Fix System Errors
items.category: Falcon Speed & Integrity Core / Integrity & Repair
items.description: [Focus: Stability] Runs SFC and DISM health repair to fix corrupted system files.
